drhp.business: The Company is engaged interalia in the business of trading and distribution of polymer products, primarily Polyethylene (PE) and Polypropylene (PP). It follows a "Stock & Sale" model in which material is imported, stored at its own warehouses and depots and subsequently supplied to customers based on their requirements. Its products are supplied to manufacturers across packaging, infrastructure, agriculture and consumer goods sectors for applications such as pipes, films, woven sacks, nonwoven fabrics, crates, containers and houseware products; the Company operates in a single segment, …

risks.note: Polymers are largely derived from petrochemical feedstocks, so fluctuations in crude oil prices have influenced polymer prices and margins across the industry; the MD&A states the polymer and petrochemical sectors remained sensitive to crude oil prices and feedstock availability, which influenced product pricing and margins throughout the year.
risks.risk: Crude oil and petrochemical feedstock price volatility

risks.note: The Directors' Report states the Company imports its goods, due to which there is an outgo of foreign exchange; the MD&A describes an operating environment characterised by foreign exchange volatility, so rupee movement feeds directly into procurement cost.
risks.risk: Foreign exchange exposure on imported material

risks.note: Disruptions in international shipping routes and logistics networks affected import lead times and procurement costs; the MD&A specifically flags the Red Sea region and the Strait of Hormuz, where any disruption or perceived risk can affect crude availability and increase freight and insurance costs.

The Board states it continuously monitors the Russia-Ukraine conflict and Middle East tensions, which have resulted in volatility in crude oil prices, shipping costs, freight rates, foreign exchange and global supply chains - all of which pass through an import-dependent trading model.
risks.risk: Geopolitical conflict exposure in a globally sourced supply chain

risks.note: Management cites diversified sourcing arrangements, strong supplier relationships and prudent inventory planning as the mechanisms through which the Company absorbed the year's disruption, which places imported inventory held between purchase and sale at the centre of the risk the Company manages.
risks.risk: Inventory and sourcing risk inherent to the imported stock-and-sale model

risks.note: The Company's position is described in the Directors' Report as the Authorized Distributor of Borouge Pte Ltd since 2001 for the ISC Region and amongst its leading distributors consistently for the last 20 years; the business is therefore built on continuity of a small number of global principal relationships.

The MD&A states businesses continued to operate in an environment of heightened uncertainty, fluctuating commodity prices and evolving trade dynamics, alongside trade uncertainties and inflationary pressures during FY 2025-26.
risks.risk: Exposure to global trade and demand uncertainty
